rows.name: Seed Swap
rows.line: Bring spare seeds to the plaza and trade for something new.
rows.line_gang: Crates of spare seeds change hands on the docks all morning.

rows.name: Kite Day
rows.line: Kites over the hill north of town all afternoon.

rows.name: Rooftop Kite Wars
rows.line_gang: Crews fly kites off the rooftops: last kite up wins bragging rights.

rows.name: Beach Cleanup Day
rows.line: Help tidy the beach: shells and driftwood make good trades.

rows.name: Street Art Jam
rows.line_gang: Paint the underpass: the best wall gets a spot in the Hideout.

rows.name: Meteor Watch
rows.line: Stay up late: shooting stars after dark, make a wish.
rows.line_gang: Up on the roof after dark: shooting stars over the skyline.

rows.name: Apple Picking Day
rows.line: The orchard trees are heavy: pick a basket on the hill.

rows.name: Scrap Swap
rows.line_gang: Swap meet behind the docks: parts, tools and odd finds.

rows.name: Founders' Day
rows.line: Every second year the town remembers its founders with a picnic on the plaza.
rows.line_gang: Every second year the old crews raise a toast of soda to the founders.

rows.name: Ice Fishing Day
rows.line: The lake is frozen hard: fish through the ice all day.
rows.line_gang: The harbour edge has frozen: fishing holes all along the pier.

rows.name: Snowball Saturday
rows.line: Snowball fights in the park: soft snow, big laughs.
rows.line_gang: Snowball turf war in the park: soft snow, no hard feelings.

rows.name: Snow Sculpture Contest
rows.line: Build the best snow sculpture on the plaza.
rows.line_gang: Ice sculptures under the neon: best one wins.
